definitions.full: H1266. beroth [ בְּרוֺת ] noun masculine id. (Aramaic (probably North-Palestinian) form of same) only plural בְּרוֺתִים || אֲרָזִים Song 1:17 ; reference to arbour of trees as their home, compare אֶרֶז .
